backup.title: Backup & Restore
backup.subtitle: Full database backup to PC or cloud, scheduled backups, restore old data
backup.setupProtectionHint: Clearing browser cache will NOT show setup again. Only Super Admin factory reset unlocks setup wizard.
backup.guideIntro: Save all bills, customers, users and settings — locally or in the cloud.
backup.guideStep1: Daily: Overview tab → Backup to PC or Backup to Cloud.
backup.guideStep2: Auto: Schedule tab → pick Daily/Weekly/Monthly → Save Schedule.
backup.guideStep3: New Firebase: Migrate tab → export → import on new project → confirm → archive.
backup.guideStep4: Restore: History → cloud restore, or Overview → Restore from File (JSON).
backup.guideStep5: Lighten load: Maintenance or Migrate → soft archive (data stays, not deleted).
backup.backupPcDesc: Download full JSON — bills, customers, settings
backup.backupCloudDesc: Save full backup online — restore from any device
backup.restoreFileDesc: Upload a previously downloaded JSON backup

backup.noBackupsDesc: Create a manual backup or enable automatic schedule.

backup.clearCacheDesc: Wipes offline drafts and sync queue. Setup lock preserved.
backup.factoryResetDesc: Removes setup lock. Setup wizard shows again. Type FACTORY RESET.

migrate.exportDesc: Full package: orders, customers, users, settings + local data. For new Firebase project.
migrate.importStep2: Deploy this POS app with new .env keys.

migrate.importStep4: Login and verify bills, customers, users on new project.
migrate.confirmDesc: Confirm migration before archiving main project. Data is soft-archived — not hard deleted.
migrate.quickArchiveDesc: Backup + soft-archive old orders/logs to reduce main load.
migrate.footerNote: Hard delete is never used for bills by default. Archived data stays in Firestore — restore anytime.
